name: 25D-NBOMe
summary: Uncommon analogue of 2C-D. Extremely potent psychedelic with stimulating qualities. The drug can cause dangerous vasoconstriction at high doses. May induce uncomfortable body load.

pharmacology.text: 25D-NBOMe acts on multiple serotonin receptors, including as a full agonist at the 5-HT2A receptor. It also interacts with multiple adrenergic receptors, such as α1A and α2A receptors. The drug produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic-like effects, in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 25D-NBOMe has been sold as a street drug since 2010 and produces effects in humans comparable to related compounds such as 25I-NBOMe and 25C-NBOMe. It was banned as a Temporary Class Drug in the UK on 10 June 2013 after concerns about its recreational use.
